notes: Riveted sage-green steel water tower. The scale bar is about 52 px/m, so it is about 10.2 m tall. It has a 4.25 m tank with a shallow cone roof and a curved bottom on a 5 m round balcony, four splayed legs with X-bracing on concrete footings, a central riser pipe, and a caged ladder on the front-right (+x,+z) with a roof hatch nearby. The top view reads about 10% larger than the elevations. The sheet's ladder foot is inconsistent between views, so I resolved it at the front-right footing.
